avis.texte: Bought this on promotion months ago, I took it out of my collection of skincare products and have been absolutely wowed. I've been removing eye makeup for decades and tried dozens of products, but never wowed until now. This stuff is magic. It melts heavy waterproof make up in seconds. It doesn't bother my eyes and leaves no residue. I need to look no further, this is becoming part of my skincare routine.

avis.titre: Got it during 21 days sale and I won't repurchase
avis.texte: This doesn't rinse off easy and left a white film. I prefer the the other actual liquid oil cleanser or the Elemis Cleansing Balm over this.

I'm thanking the skincare gods for Hanksin's AHA cleansing balm. The lemon smell is subtle for those of you dubious of scents. The biggest thing for me is the price point. There are so many cleansing balms that are double the price or more and do the exact same thing (sometimes they aren't as good!) A little goes a LONG way, and it takes off all my make up no problem (and sometimes I can go a lil ham on eye makeup). For those of you moping about double cleansing, look up the benefits of double cleansing! Since I have dry skin, I only use micellar water in the morning, so double cleansing is safe for my skin at night. The biggest setback is cleansing balms are messy, but thats kind of just the nature of the beast. Go ahead darlin', take a chance!

This cleansing balm is amazing and leaves your skin feeling so soft! Eye makeup will come off as long as you emulsify the product. It is not often that I use a cleanser and it doesn't feel dry and tight afterwards. I have used other cleansing balms/oils but they don't compare. I highly recommend!

I love thus product and the way my skin feels after using. It melts my eye makeup for easy removal. Let me say that no, it doesn't COMPLETELY remove my eye makeup, but what cleanser does? I do have some residual that needs to be removed with a minimum of eyemake remover. A little of this balm goes a long way. One of my favorite products for my 60+ years skin!

A balm or oil cleanser is meant to be part of a DOUBLE CLEANSE!!!! Do not use this product and nothing else then write a bad review stating the product left a film on your face. Its not soap! This breaks down makeup and oils and spf, you then have to use a 2nd cleanser to clean your face!!!! Stop leaving bad reviews on products you do not know how to use!!!!!

avis.titre: The best balm I've ever used
avis.texte: I LOVE THIS. Its SO similar to precleanse dermalogica. It doesnt leave a residue. Little goes a long way, gets the makeup off perfectly. More of a balm but breaks down to an oil, its not thick. Makes my skin feels wonderful. I will buy this a million times and recommend this to anyone

I love oil based facial cleansers or balms to remove makeup and give me a very moisturized feeling cleanse- this one is my new fav!! It smells amazing, removes all makeup and residue and leaves my skin feeling super soft and glowy.

I have been using this product for only 2 weeks. I have never tried this product before. I'm a cpap user so I cannot use moisturizer @ night, any longer! I was hoping this produce would give me moisture @ night & not interfere with my mask seal. It WORKS! I'm so happy with this product.
This balm works well taking off my makeup. It is moisturizing and leaves my skin feeling clean and soft. I definitely would purchase this product again.
Absolutely love this. It melts the make up off without any aggressive cleaning.
this is such a yummy cleanser. I love the texture, the smell and it brings a scoop. Will definitely buy again.
I have been using a different cleansing oil, but I tried this because it was on sale. I love the way my skin feels afterwards. Clean without drying out my skin.
leaves a layer of stiffness on the skin. doesn't remove make up either.

I usually have a problem with oil based cleasers causing break out however this product does not do thay at all. Very creamy and nice consistency, lathers into skin very well, and smells great. Makes my skin feel fresh and revived especially after a long day of wearing a full face. Love this oil cleanser and would definitely reccomend it to sensitive skin!

Ive tries a few make up removing balms and this is the best so far! Its a little more expensive than Elf or Cerave brand, but you get more product and it works better! The scent is light and refreshing. I will be buying again!

I thought it was super strange that an "oil" would help clean the oil from my pores, but it does and it's amazing! I got the bomb because I figured it would be easier to travel with, and I couldn't be more pleased. I've already recommended this to several people, and they too have been impressed.
I love this cleaning balm. a little goes a long way, smells so good, really cleanses off all make up and gets skin ready to wash with your favorite cleanser.

avis.titre: One of the best cleansing balm
avis.texte: So nice for my combination skin. I like it almost as much as the Then I Met You cleansing balm from Soko glam. Better price and clean formula. It does have a mild citrus scent, which would normally bother me, but somehow I don't mind it at all. Very good cleansing balm and I think I am ready to try other products from this brand.

I am currently on Acutane, so I was looking for an oil or balm cleanser for makeup removal before bed (as opposed to a scrub or foaming cleanser.) I wanted something that wouldn't take away the little oil that I have left and make my skin too dry. I am very satisfied with this product for several reasons: 1. It actually removes foundation. I use a gentle toner after cleansing, and there is very little leftover makeup on the cotton pad. 2. It is gentle and moisturizing. 3. It is the right price for the amount of product that you get. 4. Despite being a balm cleanser, you actually get a good lather when you add water. 5. It doesn't make me breakout.
The best cleansing balm for my dry skin. The texture is amazing and it removes my makeup perfectly. Nice cleansing balm and will continue using it.

Perfect for my combo skin. I have been using Farmacy green cleansing balm for almost year but i think I like this better.(feels a lot less waxy and more luxurious oil) It does have a citrusy scent, which I don't mind it w/this product., maybe b/c it works so well. Love it.

I love this stuff. I have super dry skin year round. So at night I use a micellar water to remove make up, then wash my face with this balm. I start with melting it in my hand and really working it into my skin, then I let it sit for a couple minutes, wet my hands well, and start "scrubbing", it changes from an oily texture to a foaming regular facewash texture. When I dont feel anymore slimy I rinse it off and it feels so clean but not tight. Also my pours have been looking so clear. The smell is very strong but doesnt bother me and the container is somewhat large but easy enough to handle.

avis.titre: Gentle AHA for sensitive skin w/scars
avis.texte: This is one of the gentlest ways to get AHA into a skincare regimen in my experience. It helps chemically exfoliate delicate skin like scar tissue which shouldn't be scrubbed harshly. It is part of a two step cleanse for some people, makeup users especially. The scent can be nauseating when I'm extremely sensitive with Lv3 Migraine, but is quite mild. It might be better in a tube, but the tub is cute and I actually like to leave it out. The generous amount lasts and I occasionally add it to my bath to be extra. 😎 This is definitely worth the money. I always have one in backup but keep giving it away because it's that special imo.

Great product. I am actually using this as a moisturizer and it has completely changed my skin for the better. Even use under my eyes and the change is noticeable . Eyecreams never really did nothing before but this really works!

I'm on my second container of this balm. I forgot to pack it on a recent trip and had to use another makeup remover and it really made me realize how much easier this cleansing balm has made my skincare routine. This stuff really gets all of my makeup off without scrubbing aggressively. Sometimes I double cleanse but a lot of the time I just call it a night after using this product because it does a great job on its own.

I've tried so many different cleansing balms and this by far is my favorite! A little bit goes a long way, it leaves my face feeling so clean and hydrated! It's got a citrus smells to it which makes it smell really good. It works well on sensitive skin also!

avis.titre: Love the way it feels - doesn't remove eye makeup very well
avis.texte: I've tried a lot of cleansing oils and balms and I really do like the way this feels on the skin as well as how it has lactic acid in it, but it doesn't not remove eye makeup well. I was not even wearing waterproof eye makeup or anything but it didn't remove my mascara or eyeliner. So I'm bummed about that and I was just using drugstore products too. Other than that it's great!

avis.titre: Love and the price point is even better!
avis.texte: Love this balm! A double cleanse has become a must in my routine and this balm has been the most effective that I have used. I have very dry skin and this works wonders!

this is not anything ive ever tried, i dont wear makeup daily, but on occasion, i honestly tried it because any other cleanser has been serious drying my skin, i used to love the olay facial wipes but they tore my skin off last time because it was so harsh, i learned my lesson, i definitely love the feeling after i use this, it makes my skin feel clean & honestly i wasnt sure since its oil, but it definitely cleans well, i wanna try a moisturizer in this if they offer it but i used the tula 24-7 hydration (also a awesome sample), & my skin is so soft & smooth

I love this product! It last some time as well, I bought one June 2021 and now I just placed an order to get another one for a refill on March 2022, granted I don't wear makeup EVERYDAY but most often than not. It doesn't cloud my eyes, I used to use "Take the day off" and I can definitely tell this product does a better job at not leaving residue on my face after my wash. I also love the little spoon comes with so I'm not dipping into the product with my hands. Worth the money and 5 stars!
This is my favorite pre-cleanse due to its consistency, efficacy, and texture. It gets the job done, doesn't cloud up my eyes, and doesn't leave an oily residue. It also lasts quite some time.

avis.titre: This product is amazing. I will never go back to makeup wipe
avis.texte: This product is amazing. I will never go back to using makeup wipes or other makeup removers. This cleans my skin like no other face wipe or wash I've ever uses. five stars for sure!!!

Been using for over a month and by far the only balm that takes all my makeup off! I then follow up with Micellar cleansing water to make sure all the make up is off and then go in with my face wash. My skin feels good and I have not experienced any break outs! Love this product!!
This made my face feel really clean and my pores look so small. it also smells good, like oranges

avis.titre: Don't know how I lived without
avis.texte: Love love!! Firstly you don't need a lot. The first time I mistakenly used too much it still worked terrifically but gosh what a waste😅 I've had a hard time with my dry skin no matter how much I've moisturized a friend of mine recommended this after he noticed I mostly had stubborn dry flakes. In addition, it helped shrink my pores remove makeup leaving my skin smooth. I made my younger sister try and she fell in love however since she's oily skin type it wasn't working 100% for her and sometimes felt too grease. so I got her the oily one and so far she's told me it's amazing! So I suggest that you take a moment to consider your skin type if not this will not work for you.💕

I use this with the Clairol cleansing milk and omg. I love it. this cleanses while not drying out or irritating my dry, sensitive skin, and I've seen a massive decrease in acne and oiliness since using it. I just bought my second bottle.

avis.titre: Love this! My new favorite product!!
avis.texte: I double cleanse my face at night & use this cleansing balm as step one. I found it through a free sample but now I buy the full size. It's a favorite for sure! It doesn't take a lot of product, it glides on smoothly & melts on my skin. It's great at removing make up & leaving my skin ready for step 2. I can't speak to how good it works on its own. Since I wear full make up daily I feel the need to also use a scrub or exfoliate of some kind. If you don't wear make up I have no doubt this product would be all you need. Smells great too!

This might have been a great product? I chose this cleansing balm because of the AHA ingredient & price but sadly, I think I might be allergic to one of its ingredients. My face & neck itches like crazy the 2 evenings I used it. I won't be using it anymore. I used a different brand before this one and I did not have any negative reactions.
Feels great! Use this to remove my sunscreen and is the first step in my night and day routine.
It removes every smidge of your makeup! Lovdd ex it and great price! It's very smooth to apply.

avis.titre: Works well as a cleanser, might be a little drying!
avis.texte: I use this to remove my make up and I feel like it works well in breaking down all types of make up. I felt like I had to double cleanse with a different (non oily) cleanser to remove any residue. I think this product would be best for oily skinned people. Since I have super dry skin it felt a little stripping.

avis.titre: Great makeup remover safe for sensitive skin
avis.texte: This product is really good. I usually take a little bit with the scooper rub it between my hands to form an oil and cleanse my whole face with it sometimes I use a little extra to go over my eyes a little goes a long way since it does turn into an oil it removes every drop of make up and then rinse and come in with a cleanser my face is no longer oily it feels clean and even when I go over it with a cotton pad with my toner there is no make up on the pad this is an A+ product not to mention it hasn't broken me out and I've used it for over a week.

If you've never tried a cleansing balm - you definitely need to try this one! I previously used a two step process (face oil and face soap) to remove my makeup every evening, but with this cleansing balm, I'm down to one step. It removes all my makeup and makes my face feel super clean without drying it out. There is a slight citrus scent I noticed in the beginning, but I don't even notice the it anymore. It's also very easy to travel with since it's not liquid. I would highly recommend.

I LOVE this product! This takes off all of my makeup even waterproof mascara. You have to get in there to take off all your makeup if you don't there might be some makeup leftover. This product takes off my makeup better than any makeup wipe has. Once I rinse it off I can feel my pores are really clean and are tightened. I recommend this product to my friends.

avis.titre: Removed my green Halloween makeup immediately!!
avis.texte: Last Halloween, I was Gamora from Guardians of the Galaxy. I used professional grade green face paint, so expected to be in the bathroom scrubbing my face all night, and still end up with green stain on my face at work the next day. Miraculously, I was done within a couple minutes with a super moisturized face, I could hardly believe it! Highly recommend.

I like to use this product to remove my makeup before I use my gel cleanser. I don't love that it leaves a residue -- I definitely don't feel completely clean after just using this product, but after a second cleanse my skin feels balanced and not tight or dry. I like that it really takes off everything, and helps combat my dry skin. It smells good, too.

This was my first cleansing balm and it went beyond my expectations. Leaves my skin feeling so smooth and clean and takes off all my makeup, even my bright red lipstick and shimmering eyeshadow with no problem and no staining or glitter leftover.

I love this cleansing balm. My skin has had no reactions and it removes makeup pretty well. I will say, it may not remove all the eye makeup especially certain mascaras but it breaks it down well enough that when used in conjunction with a gentle cleanser, your face and lashes are left really clean.

avis.titre: Love the way it makes my skin feel!
avis.texte: I use this to remove a full face of makeup at the end of the day, prior to cleansing my face. I use about a quarter sized amount and it works great! Smells yummy too. I will never go back to using makeup wipes again.
I usually use it to take off any makeup or just use it before I use a gel or foam cleanser.
This is so moisturizing and didn't flare up my chronic cystic acne. Love it!

I love this product for removing makeup! I've always double cleansed with various cleansing oils and I find that this balm emulsifies and removes my makeup so much better than any of the cleansing oils I've used. It washes off clean and doesn't leave your skin oil, which was a big pet peeve of mine.

avis.titre: Great for removing makeup and lipsense lipstick
avis.texte: I use this product to remove makeup. It has a citrus smell which I like. I have sensitive skin so it works well for my skin type. I apply it dry on my face to remove makeup. A little goes of it goes a long way. It removes even my Lipsense lipstick. The product goes on greasy but it washes off well and leaves my skin feeling smooth and soft after use.

this product removes ALL of my makeup even the waterproof i love its affordable and does what it says it does i use it to remove my makeup before i wash my face my face doesn't feel oily after rinsing it's great
I'm very skeptic about a product that I am not use to .. I must say this one works my skin is softer and moisturized.

avis.titre: Great Product for Face Cleansing - So Gentle
avis.texte: I used the product to take off my makeup and all my makeup easily came off. I love how it makes my skin feels super smooth after.

This is my first time using a cleansing balm and I love it! It smells great and does a great job taking off my makeup. It feels like my makeup melts away and it leaves my skin feeling great. I've used it for about 6 weeks and my skill feels really moisturized and vibrant. In the past few days I've received several compliments on my skin (when I haven't been wearing makeup), which prompted me to write this review. I will definitely buy it again!
I liked that I help de-contest my skin I noticed around my nose pores weren't soo congested

I absolutely love this product! My skin is very sensitive so it tends to break out with certain products, but my skin feels super fresh and clean after using this. I don't think my skin has looked this great since high school! Now I don't need to use makeup wipes or other makeup removers anymore. This product is super affordable as well!

I loved this balm. I have been looking for a balm that actually works with and leaves no greasy film yet takes off all the makeup and waterproof mascara. It was no work at all to cleanse it off. And it left my skin feeling clean yet supple.

I highly recommend this product. I've tried different cleansers and this one is at the top of my list. It's gentle on the skin yet strong enough to remove the skin's impurities and that's what I need after a long day of work. It leaves my skin feeling soft and clean after rinse. Plus, the gentle citrus smell is a bonus.

This balm is great to remove make uo, it literally melts it away. I also really like that it is delicate on my skin, I have sensitive skin and this product doesn't strip my skin, so even after using it my skin doesn't feel dry. The smells is great too.

avis.titre: WOW. this MELTS your makeup off so gently but POWERFULLY.
avis.texte: This is such a great oil cleanser!!! that means step 1 out of 2 to properly clean the skin. As stated in the directions, only a little water is needed to activate the oil like texture to MELT the makeup off your skin. then following with a foaming cleanser, your face will feel so gently cleansed but all the impurities from the day is wiped off. highly recommend. My sister, who wears heavier makeup than I do, started using this and LOVED it. it's powerful enough to get all her makeup melted off before the foam cleanser yet gentle enough for her super SENSITIVE skin

I LOVE this product and use it as my every other day exfoliator. It's especially great since I have very sensitive skin and can still use this to exfoliate away my dead skin cells, resulting in a smoother and brighter complexion. I don't wear color cosmetics much anymore, but when I do, it's typically waterproof mascara and long-wear foundation. This product is a God sent gift, as it works so beautifully as a cleanser as well. I am able to get all my makeup off with one, good face wash and then continue with my skincare routine. Will be purchasing another one here shortly!

avis.titre: One of the best makeup removers!
avis.texte: I have used a lot of cleansing balms that claim to do what this product does. Not only does it smell wonderful( citrus scent) it really does remove my toughest waterproof makeup. The cleaning balm doesn't leave the oily feeling after washing the product off, it feels clean and light. I would recommend this product!!

With the holiday season in tow, and I've been packing more makeup on more than usual, this product is a must have! It gets the job done, and it's 10x better than your average makeup wipes. It'a gentle on the skin, as you massage it all over your face instead of tugging and pulling on your skin. It also minimizes the use of "wipes/ cotton rounds" because you just use your hands! Very quick and easy. I find that it removes the toughest waterproof mascara. There is a lot of product in the container, so I don't think I'll run out anytime soon, but when I do, I will definitely be purchasing this again!
I was looking for a replacement for the Clinique balm that was a little less money. This fits the bill and works great.
This product does a great job of removing my makeup! I love how this product leaves my skin feeling healthy and moist. It's a perfect product for people who have normal to dry skin.

I have oily/combination acne-prone skin, and using an oil-based cleanser has been a game changer for me. I have previously used other Korean cleansing balms, and this one is very good. It removes all my makeup and leaves my skin soft and clean. This is very subjective, but I am not a fan of the citrusy scent. Other than that, I recommend and would personally buy again and again.

Love using this specially after wearing heavy make up. I feel like it really cleans out my pores. Also like the fact that after use, my face doesn't feel dry which is usually the case during winter. Definitely saw a difference with my pores. Less blackheads for sure.

This cleansing balm works perfect for me. I love how gentle it glides on my skin and washes away my make up well. A little definitely goes a long way. I use it everyday and don't have any complaints. I don't worry about my skin feeling dry after each wash.

I've been trying to implement an "oil cleanse" into my skin care regimen, but other products just felt greasy. THIS is what I've been looking for! A tiny bit goes a long way & it hydrates while not leaving anything behind. Absolutely fell in love after the first use. Will repurchase for sure.
I love the texture of this product. It starts off sort of creamy and then you rub it on your face and it starts to melt away with the makeup on your face. The smell is also lovely.

I have dry skin and I use it everyday for November. My skin loves it because it's not drying. I enjoy cleansing my skin everyday. It removes makeup, dirt, and oil. Highly recommend to my friends! Will buy again if I run out.
Omg. I never enjoyed cleansing my face so much. Feels so silky and moisturizing and smells so good. Left my skin feeling so fresh and clean

I love this balm! After a long day of wearing make up this product makes it so easy to remove, especially when I have waterproof liner and mascara. It hydrates my skin overnight which helps during the cold weather when my skin is dryer. My skin feels soft and fresh the next morning and the smell is awesome!

My first time trying an oil cleanser and it's been pretty good so far. I have acne-prone skin and I don't have any irritation from it. My skin isn't dry from using this cleanser. Just not a fan of citrus scent but it's not bothersome or strong. Will continue to use daily.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I recently started to use this product and i love it! I'm always looking for something thats hydrating since i have dry skin, i use this every other day and it keeps my face rich and moist without having to worry about cracking from the cold.

I don't use many products for my face but every now and then I'll indulge in something that might be better for my face. This product is nice and lightweight which is what I typically look for. I use it at night so if I wake up feeling pretty good about my face, it's usually a good sign and that's what happened.

Finally got to use this after running out of my other K-beauty cleansing balm and instantly fell in love! Compared to my old one, this one melts away makeup way faster and I can tell it is suited for dry-skin users like me. It is effective in removing my makeup and makes the process a lot easier for me. I love cleansing balms because they are easy to travel with and not messy. Also, this is going to last me a while because of its size. Lastly, it hasn't broken me out, so I know it is great even for sensitive skin. Overall, it's become my HG oil cleanser.

I use this as the first step in a double cleanse or even on its own. It melts effortlessly into my skin and rinses off thoroughly without needing to use a cloth. The scent is subtle and pleasant and it leaves my skin balanced after use. I follow this step with the hanskin hyaluron skin essence and then a cream moisturizer mixed with a few drops of plum oil.

My skin is sensitive and this cleansing balm has not caused any reactions. It easily removed all of my makeup without leaving my skin feeling stripped or dry. I have used many cleansing balms and cleansing oils in the past and many of them cause your vision to be blurry if you get them in your eyes. I have not experienced that with this product which I really appreciate!

I use this balm as my night face cleanser before I get in the shower. I don't wear too much makeup, so its more of a facial cleanser than a remover to me. I like how you put the balm into your palms and massage into your face. The citrus scent is really nice and leaves my face feeling refreshed. It is oil based, so the consistency leaves your face a bit oily, but dries off after washing. Since using the product, I felt like my pores were minimal as well. Overall, its a great product and leaves your face feeling hydrated and moisturized. If you don't like the oily feeling, you might consider double cleansing, using this product first.

I have used this product every night for two weeks now. It is very effective at getting all my make up off, including my waterproof eyeliner. Afterwards, when I use a cotton pad to apply my toner, the cotton pad is clean, showing that my face was thoroughly cleansed of all make up in dirt, but my skin does not feel tight because it is so moisturizing. You can feel the natural oils in this cleansing balm, and it also has a fresh citrusy scent to it that I really like. I would totally purchase again.

avis.titre: First time trying a cleansing balm and I approve!
avis.texte: Talk about killing 2 birds with one stone! I love how this balm both gently removes my makeup and cleanses my face. Saves me money on having to buy a face wash and makeup remover wipes separately. When the weather gets colder, I tend to switch skin products because while my face is still oily, it also gets drier. So this cleansing balm is perfect because it makes my face feel super clean yet moisturized. The product also smells nice and it's pretty affordable so that's a plus.

I'm more of a cleansing oil type of girl but I used to use cleansing balms before that so this one was something I ended up loving right away. The only downside was the scent, its not that it smells bad or anything but more that I am sensitive to smells and wasn't that fond of it. Despite that its a really good cleansing balm and gets rid of my makeup super easy and leaves my face feeling fresh and clean!

This cleansing balm is very effective at removing waterproof makeup and cleaning the skin without drying it! The AHAs remove dead skin to help your skin look and feel soft. Great for the winter or drier areas like LA.

avis.titre: Safe to Say -- I am OBSESSED
avis.texte: I hate washing my face. If I could pay someone to do it--I would. My mom uses Ponds (yes, she's that old school) which I do not like because it makes me feel oily, but one thing I do like is applying it to my face without water—and that's the best part about this! I like being able to start the cleansing process without getting my face wet. I turn on the water, and while I cleanse my face with the balm, the water has time to heat up so I don't have to put cold water on my face. The balm takes off all my makeup, and after I rinse with warm water, I don't feel oily or like there's a film on my skin—just clean, fresh, and hydrated! Be warned, if you get it in your eyes, it doesn't hurt, but your vision will be blurry for a minute!

I usually use Neutrogena Make-up Wipes or Garnier Micellar Water to remove my make up, and hope that my nightly cleanser removes the make-up that I missed. This time, I used the make-up wipe and then the pore cleansing balm, and I was pleasantly surprised on the amount of make-up it picked up! Although, I was a bit disappointed that it was not as moisturizing after washing my face. Nonetheless, it did the job.

I love cleansing balms and this is a really great one! I use it at night, and it's fantastic at thoroughly removing my make up. I also love the fresh citrus-y scent. It's very hydrating and leaves my skin feeling soft and moisturized. I love it!

This is a balm that literally melts into a luxurious oil state in the palm of your hand. It removes all of my makeup and brings impurities to the surface that washes away. Beauty product must have. Lasts a long time, I still have over a half jar left. Just use the spoon that comes with and scrape out one spoonful for your entire face and neck.

avis.titre: Perfect for the dry skin that comes with the cold!
avis.texte: I use this cleanser at night and it's great at removing makeup and not drying out my skin! My skin can get dry as it gets colder and this has been keeping it more moisturized.

I absolutely love how this balm is so gentle on my skin. My pores are so thankful! I love the gentle smell when it hits the face. I like to use my cleansing cloth so this is the perfect balm to help clean and exfoliate my face. I'll be needing a couple more of these to give out as gifts!
Removes all my eye makeup and foundation. I like how it has AHAs in the formula too which exfoliates the skin and takes the dead skin cells away.

I have used at least half a dozen cleansing oils and balms and this might be my favorite one. The other ones leave a slight residue on my eyelashes which sometimes causes my eyes to burn but this one does not irritate my eyes and it is also surprisingly hydrating. I use this as a first step to remove all makeup followed by cleanser and toner. Highly recommend. The only negative for me (and this is highly subjective) is that it smells like patchouli which I dislike but that's just me. the product is amazing.

This balm does a great job of removing all my makeup and cleansing my skin. I like to use a muslin cloth with it, and sometimes will double cleanse. I have dry skin and have issues with cleansers being harsh but this one leaves my skin feeling clean but still supple. Would highly recommend!

This balm is so gentle, but actually cleans your skin and removes all makeup. It feels a bit like coconut oil when you first put it on, but foams up a little once you add water. I tend to get some redness after cleansing, but this leaves my skin glowing!

avis.titre: It worked great and smelled great!
avis.texte: I used this product for about 3 weeks and I think overall it worked great! I have combination skin and I really liked it since it didn't make me any oilier and didn't make me feel too dry. I used it primarily to remove all of my makeup. I didn't really notice any difference with my pores but it did remove my makeup really well. I still followed up with a cleanser after. It has a really strong citrusy smell but I actually like that kind of smell so it's okay with me. It would've been 5 stars but I found the lid kind of hard to close. Sometimes it wouldn't twist evenly and I'm not quite sure why but it would result in the container not being closed all the way if I didn't notice and fix it.

This helped soften the fine lines on my forehead! I use to use Erborian solid cleansing oil, but this is a much better deal, (half the price, twice the product!) with better results. This cleansing balm cleans off the extra gunk you collect from makeup, smog, & pollution. My skin feels extra supple and looks a lot brighter too because of the AHAs. Has a peppy citrus scent. Highly recommend.

I have been using this cleanser for over a week and fallen in love. When I take off my makeup with past cleansers, it has always made my skin feel dry and tight. This soft chemical exfoliation cleansing balm does it all for me! It removes my makeup and target my skincare problems which is great for someone that gets lazy or has a busy schedule. I do see a lot of improvement with my skin tone and texture. The plus side, the balm is super affordable.

This was my first time using a cleansing balm and I am a convert! It melts my make up right off and leaves my skin feeling refreshed after. I do still use another cleanser after, but could be happy without doing that.

I'd never used a cleansing balm before. only oil. But wow, I will never go back. This is excellent for my dry skin. I haven't had any breakouts and my skin actually feels clean, not greasy, afterward. I still use a regular cleanser after this most of the time but still feel clean when I don't. It's gentle enough to use for mascara but powerful enough to get rid of everything without stripping your skin. Hands down amazing. I will absolutely repurchase this and have already recommended it to a fellow dry-skin homie.

I always use a cleansing balm, but when I saw this I was intrigued. I don't use exfoliators as much as I should for fear of over doing it and damaging my skin barrier. But, I thought I'd give this a try as I prefer chemical exfoliation instead of physical. This did not disappoint! I love multitasking products! It reduces the risk of over-exfoliation because you are using it t remove makeup and oil, and behind the scenes it is doing it's magic! My skin looks healthier, and the texture has improved! Great product!

I have extremely dry sensitive skin. I also wear makeup everyday to work and it is on my skin for at least 11 hours. Plus, I live in the city....lots of smog and stuff. So, taking care of my skin is important. I picked this up when it first launched, the claims were intriguing. I have been using it consistently now for 2 weeks and my skin looks better than it has in a very long time! I am hydrated, the texture is much smoother and I just look healthy and beautiful. I have not noticed a decrease in wrinkles, ( I am 54), but I truly was not expecting too. My pores have not disappeared but they have become smaller in size. The product itself is a balm. It comes with a tiny spatula, which I like. You pick up a small amount, warm it up on your fingers than apply to face. It smells clean and like oranges. If you are sensitive to scents you might want to steer clear or test it out first. The fun part is when you activate the balm with warm water. You place some water on your face and the product turns a milky white. And it just feels so nice. After rinsing and patting dry you can add your favorite moisturizer but honestly I have not needed to. Does it remove all makeup? Yes. I have been putting it through the paces. I have not removed any makeup with wipes before using this product and it has taken everything off;mascara, lippies, blush, bronzer, foundation....all of it. I highly recommend this product and will definitely be repurchasing.
